scope: one pull request per service into develop
production promotion of exact development-tested artifacts
authorization.stageControl: Root opens PRs and owns merges/deployment. All source checkpoints, pins and tests must be complete first.

retainedEvidence.scope: Exact service blocks and surfaces retained; application checkouts are not rescanned.

localValidation.api: Complete gofmt/build/vet/race passed after final corpus copy

consumerPinInstructions.target: Resolve self to this immutable Landing commit SHA before remote CI. Landing keeps self; do not create a self-reference commit cycle.

releaseGates: All help contracts agree with the actual immutable documentation snapshot.
All required PR checks pass before merging.
Deploy API, then compatible Website before Admin.
Match the public help corpus and API support revision before promotion.
Verify development and promote those exact artifacts without rebuilding.
